summary: Suggests a mail mapping between X.400 (1988) or ISO 10021 messages and RFC 822 messages, for the Internet and UK Academic communities. It is experimental and not a standard. It updates RFCs 822, 987, and 1026. It was replaced by RFC 1327 and RFC 2156.

eli5.summary: Two mail systems use different formats. This is a translation guide so a letter from one can be read by the other.

questions: how to gateway x.400 and internet mail
